videos.title: The future of AI in Global Health research
videos.description: What a pleasure it was to have Rohit Malpani and Peiling Yap on the show, editors of a new journal about AI in Global health. This one is for researchers, implementers of digital and AI tools in low resource settings. We cover: The challenges for people in the so called Global South to have a leading voice in academia.…

videos.title: Why no child and maternal health innovation? Hot take!
videos.description: GPODH on the road. I sat down with Jhonatan Bringas (digitalhealthdoc on IG), CEO and founder of Lapsi Health and Keikku. This was great fun, and we just embraced the fact that we were in a busy throughfare at the last day of the conference at HLTH Europe. Check out more hot takes from people across digital health at gpodh.org/videos.…

videos.title: Hot take. AI regulation. Have we got it backwards?
videos.description: I caught up with Professor of regulatory science Stephen Gilbert at HLTH Europe on his thoughts about where we could or should be headed with regulating AI in healthcare Have we got it wrong thinking about this as a medical device or regulating agents how we might regulate clinicians? Tasty stuff. Check out the full hot takes series with GPODH on the road, and our brand new website at gpodh.org

videos.title: Hot takes AI and digital health. Do the BORING stuff!
videos.description: I caught up at HLTH Europe with Haris Shuaib, founder and CEO of Newton's Tree to hear his hot take on - every dollar spent on tech innovation needs 5 on implementation - health tech is not like building an Angry birds (or any phone gaming) app - we need more boring stuff that matters - an extra bonus hot take A great hot take with a great human! Thanks Haris! What do you think?…

videos.title: Hot Takes  Social Media Ban in the UK with Vishaal Virani of Youtube Health
videos.description: I caught up with Head of Youtube Health to discuss the UK's recent announcement on the social media ban for under 16s. Was it the right decision? Vishaal explains how a ban may not necessarily tackle the root cause. We have a back and forth around the concerns parents have about risks and harms, vs the potential benefits and the work Youtube has been doing to mitigate this.…

videos.title: HLTH Hot Takes - Withings (Antoine Pivron)
videos.description: GPODH on the road at HLTH Europe with Hot takes. Grilling digital health leaders about what we need to do better in our inudstry. We caught up with Antoine Pivron from Withings Health Solutions on how to do better on health prevention. Check out our hot takes series.

videos.title: HLTH Hot Takes - Nabla (Laurie Soffiati)
videos.description: GPODH on the road at HLTH Europe with Hot takes. Grilling digital health leaders about what we need to do better in our inudstry. We caught up with Laurie Soffiati of Nabla Health Check out our hot takes series.

videos.title: HLTH Hot Takes - Doctolib (Stanislas Niox-Chateau)
videos.description: Hot takes. What do we need to do better on in the digital health industry. We hit the road to ask leaders in health tech on their biggest hot takes. Here's CEO of Doctolib, Stanislas Niox-Chateau on that really matters to create real value for clinicians. Part of our GPODH.org on the road series at HLTH Europe in 2026. Check out our other hot takes.

videos.title: HLTH Hot Takes - Health Inequities
videos.description: GPODH.org went on the road to HLTH Europe in June 2026. Here's part 1 of Hot takes, talking about what we need to do better on in the digital health industry. What antipatterns we need to change and act better on. I took aside some of the fantastic folks at our digital health inequities session to get their hot takes. Prof Jenny Shand, health economist at UCL spoke about value and the ROI case.…

videos.title: HIMSS hot takes: doing better with AI in healthcare
videos.description: At HIMSS Europe, I got together with some fantastic podcasters who care about what matters in healthcare. What are some things we need to do better on implementing tech and AI in healthcare? With Valentine Kamau of @AIHealthBeatPodcast , Tjasa Zjac of@facesofdigitalhealth and Claire Murigande from @NarrativesofPurpose

videos.title: AI in low resource settings. What developers should know
videos.description: Whilst it is true that in low resource settings, access is a challenge and therefore more likely that the benefits outweight risks compared to the baseline, developers still need to to take a responsible approach on building the right way. Joe Alderman shares his insights ont he gpodh.org podcast. Get the full insights here on what it takes to create AI for underserved communities.…

videos.title: Saving lives with drones
videos.description: Echo Vanderwal of The Luke Commission in Eswatini talks about how they built a locally maintained drone system to help deliver vital medicines like snake antivenom and other critical medicines to people when they needed them. The impact was incredible. That year, they reduced snakebite deaths (previously a near certainty) to ZERO in the country.…

videos.title: Founder challenges in refugee digital health
videos.description: Founder, Aral Surmeli talks about the challenges building HERA digital health, a digital tool for Syrian refugees in Turkey. Aral talks about how HERA were affected by the USAID funding cuts and stop work order in Feb 2025. Check out the full episode, full of real talk and insight : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l_p3zJGFKf0

videos.title: Digital health and AI in healthcare hot takes #3
videos.description: The third instalment of unfiltered hot takes on AI and digital health,what is working, what is hype, and what the field needs to hear.

videos.title: Digital innovation in humanitarian settings
videos.description: How does an organisation like the ICRC - working in conflict zones, disasters, and last-mile settings - approach digital transformation? Javier Elkin spent three years building the ICRC's digital health unit from scratch, covering prioritisation frameworks, DHIS2 implementation, and the MOOVE/Medotron initiative to validate LLMs for humanitarian settings.

videos.title: USAID cuts, women's health and leading the right way
videos.description: A direct conversation about the impact of USAID funding cuts on women's health programmes globally, and what principled leadership looks like when the landscape shifts rapidly.

videos.title: Why displaced people need a digital identity
videos.description: Without a digital identity, displaced people cannot access healthcare, financial services, or legal protection. This talk explores why digital identity is foundational infrastructure for refugee and migrant health.

videos.title: Digital health and AI in healthcare hot takes #2
videos.description: More unfiltered takes on the state of AI and digital health,from the overhyped to the genuinely transformative.

videos.title: Digital health and AI in healthcare hot takes #1
videos.description: The first in a series of sharp, direct takes on AI and digital health,cutting through the noise to what actually matters.

videos.title: Evaluation Level Up: Measuring what matters
videos.description: A practical guide to levelling up how digital health programmes are evaluated,moving beyond vanity metrics toward evidence that actually drives decisions and funding.

videos.title: Social impact in a time of scarcity, and the power of community
videos.description: How do organisations sustain social impact when resources are scarce? This conversation explores community-led approaches and what it means to build resilience into health programmes.

videos.title: Digital health innovation with refugee communities: a founder's story
videos.description: A founder's first-hand account of building digital health tools with and for refugee communities,the challenges, the pivots, and what it actually takes to do this work with integrity.

videos.title: Quick insight: How to level up your evidence comms in digital health
videos.description: A short, practical guide to communicating evidence more effectively in digital health,what funders, policy makers, and implementers actually want to see.

videos.title: Evolving beyond verticals and funding what matters in healthcare
videos.description: Why the siloed, disease-specific model of global health funding is holding back progress,and what a systems-oriented approach to investment could look like instead.

videos.title: Healthtech comms: communicating your impact with great storytelling
videos.description: James Somauroo of SomX on why most digital health organisations communicate badly, how great storytelling changes that, and the frameworks that actually work for impact-driven brands.

videos.title: HLTH Europe 2025 spotlight: Local ownership lessons from Malawi
videos.description: A spotlight conversation from HLTH Europe 2025 on what genuine local ownership looks like in digital health,drawing on hard-won lessons from implementation in Malawi.

videos.title: HLTH Europe 2025 spotlight: Remidio,scaling from India to Europe and the US
videos.description: A spotlight conversation from HLTH Europe 2025 with Remidio on the journey of scaling an AI-powered ophthalmology device from India to global markets,and what that path reveals about regulation, evidence, and market access.

videos.title: How the World Health Organization is evolving, with WHO Digital Director Alain Labrique
videos.description: Alain Labrique, Director of Digital Health and Innovation at WHO, on how the organisation is navigating digital transformation, AI governance, and its role in shaping global digital health norms.

videos.title: Implementation 101 and how to fail well
videos.description: A grounded look at the realities of implementing digital health in low-resource settings,including the failure modes nobody talks about and what it actually means to learn from them.

videos.title: From crisis to revolution: why Africa's moment is now,a healthtech VC's case
videos.description: A venture capital perspective on why the confluence of mobile penetration, young demographics, and healthcare need makes Africa the most compelling opportunity in global healthtech right now.

videos.title: Regulatory strategy for founders and policy makers
videos.description: Demystifying the regulatory landscape for digital health,how founders should think about regulatory strategy early, and what policy makers need to understand about the tools they are overseeing.

videos.title: Health First, Innovation Second
videos.description: A provocative argument for recentering health outcomes,not technological novelty,as the primary metric for digital health success. What changes when you genuinely put health first?

videos.title: Digital mental health research insights with Lucy Cesnakova from DiME
videos.description: Lucy Cesnakova from the Digital Medicine Society (DiME) shares research insights on digital mental health,what the evidence says, where the gaps are, and how researchers are navigating a fast-moving space.

videos.title: Making ethics actionable in digital health with Jess Morley
videos.description: Jess Morley on moving beyond ethics washing,how to embed genuine ethical reasoning into the design, deployment, and governance of digital health tools, particularly those using AI.

videos.title: Policy insights from the Rwanda Ministry of Health and FIND
videos.description: A conversation at the intersection of national digital health policy and diagnostic innovation,drawing on Rwanda's experience as one of Africa's most ambitious digital health implementers.

videos.title: Co-designing mental health solutions with young people in Rwanda
videos.description: What does genuine co-design look like when building digital mental health tools with young people in Rwanda? This conversation explores methodology, power dynamics, and what it means to design with,not for.

videos.title: Supporting rural healthcare in India with technology
videos.description: How technology is being deployed to reach rural and last-mile communities in India,the infrastructure challenges, the human factors, and the solutions that are actually working at scale.

videos.title: Impactful digital health transformation through a clear vision and values: insights from Eswatini
videos.description: Lessons from Eswatini's digital health transformation journey,how a clear national vision and grounded values shaped the choices made, the partnerships formed, and the outcomes achieved.

videos.title: What is the right approach for regulation and evaluation of digital health technologies?
videos.description: A critical look at how digital health technologies should be regulated and evaluated,balancing innovation with safety, and speed with rigour, particularly in low- and middle-income country contexts.

videos.title: Creating impact with AI in isolated communities
videos.description: How AI tools are being designed and deployed to reach communities with limited connectivity and infrastructure,and what it takes to make impact real rather than theoretical in these contexts.

videos.title: Bridging the Gap: The Last Mile of Healthcare with Bilal Mateen, Digital Square @ PATH
videos.description: Bilal Mateen of Digital Square at PATH on the persistent challenge of reaching the last mile in healthcare,what the data shows, what the evidence supports, and where the biggest leverage points lie.

videos.title: Trailer: Global Perspectives on Digital Health Podcast
videos.description: An introduction to the Global Perspectives on Digital Health podcast,who it is for, what it covers, and why these conversations matter.

videos.title: Health Data Poverty (Part 1) with Dr Xiao Liu
videos.description: Dr Xiao Liu on the concept of health data poverty,why the systematic under-representation of low- and middle-income country populations in global health datasets is a structural problem with real consequences for AI and digital health.

videos.title: Health Data Poverty (Part 2) with Professor Alexandre Filho
videos.description: Professor Alexandre Filho continues the health data poverty conversation,exploring the structural causes, the geopolitical dimensions, and what it would take to build genuinely representative global health data infrastructure.
